task_description: Build a Google Apps Script web app called 'QA - Daily Status Dashboard' that reads the 5-tab QA team Google Sheet (members: Isra, Sowmiya, Keerthana, Yogesh, Tamizharasi) and renders an elegant dashboard with: (1) a banner + interactive per-member buttons, (2) a 3D-style chart section with smooth animations, (3) KPI cards for all 5 resources, and (4) a sortable/searchable filtered task table. All source files live under a new `apps-script/` folder; the existing Java samples in src/ and bin/ remain untouched.

verification.summary: No build or test runner exists for Apps Script offline; this was documented in context.json. Static verification: appsscript.json parses, all 9 server functions (doGet, include, getMembers, getConfig, getMemberTasks, getAllTasks, getMemberSummary, getAllSummaries, getChartData) defined, CacheService used 4x in DataService.gs, every <?!= include('X') ?> resolves to an existing apps-script/X.html, all CDN URLs are HTTPS, Javascript.html has both google.script.run wiring and a MOCK fallback, file sizes Banner=89 Index=95 Stylesheet=612 Javascript=1062 Code.gs=126 DataService.gs=516 README=198 lines after all review iterations. Existing src/, bin/, top-level README.md byte-identical. No Dockerfile in repo. test_quality is n/a because the project ships no automated test suite (Apps Script is impractical to run offline without node + apps-script-mock); behavior must be exercised in the deployed web app.

residual_followups: No automated tests (project-level constraint, no test framework offline).
Partial-mock state can still mix real and mock slices but is now legibly labelled by panel.
MOCK_MEMBERS and MEMBER_SHEETS are hand-coupled for fully-offline standalone preview when both getMembers and getAllTasks fail.
